decision_vocabulary.adopt: Use substantially as-is under its own authority.
decision_vocabulary.adapt: Use the model or workflow while implementing a bounded local form.
decision_vocabulary.wrap: Keep the system in service behind a replaceable adapter.
decision_vocabulary.donor: Harvest patterns, vocabulary, tests, and failure cases without importing runtime code.
decision_vocabulary.hold: Do not operationalize until the named qualification gap is closed.
decision_vocabulary.build: Implement only the thin capability that remains uniquely Manzanita's.

components.name: MyTurn
components.current_use: Essential Tools inventory, membership, reservations, checkout, and return workflow.
components.admission_note: Public API coverage is a subset and subscription-dependent; exports remain part of the replacement path.
components.replacement_test: The commons can preserve people, projects, intents, commitments, receipts, and credit history if MyTurn is replaced.

components.name: Stripe
components.current_use: Optional card processing where MyTurn or a fundraising platform requires it.
components.admission_note: Avoidance is not a launch requirement. Replaceability and export are requirements.
components.replacement_test: A processor change does not alter the capacity model or erase nonfinancial participation.

components.name: ValueFlows
components.current_use: Semantics for agents, resources, intents, commitments, and observed events.
components.admission_note: Adopt compatible meanings where they reduce reinvention; retain Manzanita-specific policy and receipt law.
components.replacement_test: The local JSON remains intelligible without a ValueFlows runtime.

components.name: TimeOverflow
components.current_use: Study member, offer, demand, accounting, and offline-administration workflows.
never_canonical_for: Manzanita production runtime until license and fit admission
components.admission_note: AGPL-3.0 code. Pattern harvesting is admitted; code incorporation requires an explicit license and architecture decision.
components.replacement_test: No TimeOverflow code is required for the v0.1 operating slice.

components.name: CiviCRM / CiviVolunteer
components.current_use: Study contact, project, opportunity, signup, contribution, and actual-hours workflows.
components.admission_note: Potentially useful when six people become sixty and local packet exchange stops being sufficient.
components.replacement_test: The v0.1 tool does not require a CRM or server.

components.name: Credit Commons
components.current_use: Study independent-ledger federation after one local ledger is honestly operated.
components.admission_note: The reference implementation identifies itself as proof of concept; federation is downstream of a proven local exchange.
components.replacement_test: No federation dependency exists in the pilot.

components.name: Hyperswitch
components.current_use: None. Revisit only if multi-processor routing becomes an actual requirement.
components.admission_note: Apache-2.0 and multi-processor by design, but far beyond the needs of the first six-person pilot.
components.replacement_test: The pilot does not deploy payment orchestration.

components.name: Givebutter
components.admission_note: Qualify export, API, processor dependency, data rights, fees, and termination path before adoption.
components.replacement_test: Fundraising remains one view and one adapter, never the operating core.

components.name: Network for Good
components.admission_note: The reported internal transaction or ledger capability remains unqualified until exact product terms and export behavior are inspected.
components.replacement_test: A fundraising platform can disappear without erasing participation history.

components.name: Manzanita Essential Capacity
components.current_use: Own the cross-domain identities, projects, intents, commitments, accepted events, credits, evidence, policy, adapter registry, and portable handoff.
never_canonical_for: physical checkout unless receipted by custody system
components.admission_note: This is the thin layer that other systems do not supply together.
components.replacement_test: All state exports as plain JSON and can be reconstructed without this interface.
